name: House of Petals
source:
You awaken in the serene yet unfamiliar Lotus Pavilion, with no memory of who you are or how you got there. Beside you is Han—a gentle, soft-spoken artist who claims to be your husband. He insists you simply suffered a fall and lost your memory. Everything he does seems devoted to your comfort… but the more you explore your surroundings, the more unsettling things become. Is Han truly who he says he is? And more importantly—who are you? 4 days is all you have to survive and find out the truth.

[From [url=https://littlesnakestudio.itch.io/broken-fate]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在宁静而又陌生的莲花亭中醒来，不记得自己是谁，也不记得自己是如何到达那里的。在你旁边的是韩——一位温柔、说话轻声细语的艺术家，自称是你的丈夫。他坚称你只是摔倒并失去了记忆。他所做的一切似乎都是为了让你感到舒适……但你越探索周围的环境，事情就会变得越令人不安。韩真的是他所说的那个人吗？更重要的是——你是谁？4天的时间就是你生存并找出真相的时间。

[来自[url=https://littlesnakestudio.itch.io/broken-fate]itch.io[/url]]
